messages:
incident-bot: P0 alert — Canary rollout v2.3.4 failing 5xx on checkout route. Automated rollback initiated but telemetry shows ~30% traffic still hitting the new variant (session affinity). Paging on-call.

alex: ack oncall here, looking. Can someone paste rollout ID and current traffic split?

deploy-bot: rollout_id=rl-2026-03-17-09, automated_rollback=initiated, rollback_status=PARTIAL, affected_route=/checkout, error_rate=12%->3% after rollback start.

priya_k: tl;dr — the autoscript reverted service version but load-balancer sticky cookie TTL kept users pinned to canary pods that were put into Terminating state -> 503s for pinned connections.

dan_ops: thanks. Sounds like session affinity. We can either flip feature flag to force route to stable OR drain pods aggressively (force-terminate). Preference for flag flip to minimize client impact.

maya_infra: +1 for flag flip. Quick checklist: confirm control plane saw rollback. If control plane missed some nodes due to conn limit, LB still points to IPs. I'm ssh-ing to lb-02 to check stick tables.

nina_cs: CS: seeing a handful of customers reporting checkout failures in EU. Any ETA on mitigation? Need to prepare temporary banner if longer than 15m.

alex: @priya_k please try feature-flag kill switch (route-checkout->stable) now and post command. If that fails, we'll drain.

priya_k: running flag toggle:
```bash
curl -X POST https://flags.redwood.internal/api/toggle \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $FLAG_OPS' \ 
  -d '{"flag":"route-checkout","value":"stable-only","rollout_id":"rl-2026-03-17-09"}'
```

deploy-bot: flag_toggle status=OK, propagation=80% (10s)

maya_infra: lb-02 stick table shows 27 sessions bound to canary IPs with TTL 24h. Flag propagated but existing sessions still sticky. We'll run graceful drain script to migrate sessions.

dan_ops: run traffic-siphon to move active sessions off canary pods: `./tools/traffic-siphon --from canary --to stable --concurrency 50`

priya_k: started siphon (pid 3214). logs: "siphon: 0 errors, 12 sessions migrated, 15 pending"

jamie_qa: running quick smoke against /checkout (EU region):
```bash
for i in {1..10}; do curl -sS -I -H 'Host: eu.redwood' https://api.redwood.com/checkout | head -n 1; done
```
results: 10/10 200 OK via stable after flag flip+siphon.

nina_cs: thanks — I'll tell CS to send interim message: "We're investigating transient checkout errors for some EU customers; retries are working. Engineers are mitigating."

alex: can we capture verification checklist before we close?
- deploy-bot: rollback_status=COMPLETE (control plane sees stable only)
- maya_infra: lb stick table entries for canary=0
- priy_k: siphon exit code=0, migrated=27
- jamie_qa: smoke tests 200 OK x 30
- nina_cs: CS message posted to affected customers

priya_k: all checks green, monitoring trending back to baseline. Will keep an eye for 20m then close.

dan_ops: note: follow-up action to add short TTL for cookie on canary deployments to avoid future stickiness. Filing infra ticket.

alex: thanks team. I'll mark incident as mitigated, leaving postmortem task for root cause + flag TTL change.

incident-bot: Incident P0 -> mitigated at 1764000075. Postmortem assigned: eng-infra#4721.

priya_k: closing thread from oncall perspective. :white_check_mark:
